notes.title: Bugfix
notes.notes:
*Fixed a bug that caused Lucas's skill "Yang" that would increase MP at sacrifice to TP to actually give back some MP!

Also, the game will never sell another copy. Don't know why I even put it up. People don't want to admit to knowing me.

Thanks AWperative (Jose) and Cupricdaiiiger (Max) for bug testing.

notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.notes: When the player enters the docks with the boat (but not ship) it would not allow them to reenter through the dock as it would with the ship. This should be fixed.

notes.title: Minor bug fix (2/23)
notes.notes: One treasure chest in the Mountain Cave no longer crashes the game.

notes.title: October 9 Update
notes.notes:
This update contains a fix to incorrect instructions provided for controller users.

Here is a recap:

X = Choose/Select
A = Dash
B = Cancel/Open Menu on Map
